entries.name: Nimue's home
entries.content:
Nimue's home is a large wood cabin located in the mountains. It has several rooms and even an open air hot spring where she bathes.
Her cabin has a living area with several book shelves, a large rug, and several chairs and couches. There is also a large fireplace.
She has a kitchen with a dining area.
Her bedroom has a massive soft and warm bed with several warm comforters and pillows. She also has a large vanity and a big walk in closet.
She also has a guest room where she lets people sleep.
The last room is where she performs her potion making and spell crafting. It has several tables and cabinets for materials. There is also a massive cauldron where she brews her potions.
